owner_authorization.interpreted_scope: Remove L1.5 from the research pipeline, retain its historical failure artifacts, and rebuild the same side-specific L2 directly from the frozen L1 episode ledger.

question: Can the L1-to-L2 path be rebuilt with no L1.5 import, feature, score, threshold, model, or filtering dependency while exactly reproducing the prior L2-only arm?
single_variable: Pipeline topology only: bypass L1.5. The frozen L1 episode ledger, dependency representatives, LONG/SHORT split, 17 L2 features, LightGBM parameters, tune-q90 thresholds, final period, outcomes, costs, matched controls and economic gates stay unchanged.

pipeline.candidate_flow: L1 frozen candidate ledger -> dependency_representative episode collapse -> LONG/SHORT L2
pipeline.l15_policy: historical research only; not imported, read, scored or gated by this runner

l2.objective: side-specific LightGBM regression on gross realized_ret
l2.score_gate: per-side tune q90, frozen before final

bypass_parity: runner imports no L1.5 or global-shape module
candidate CSV is read with an explicit column allow-list containing no l15 field
new LONG and SHORT model SHA-256 values equal the prior L2-only arm
new and prior per-event scores differ by at most 1e-12
tune-q90 thresholds and selected episode IDs are identical
economic_gate: complete matched-control coverage and beat all eight assignments
neither side frozen-q90 net mean negative
acceptance.decision_rule: Topology bypass may pass while the L2 economic gate remains rejected. Bypass parity does not make the model production eligible.
